This confirms extraction structure only. No independent collation against the printed edition or Greek Septuagint was performed; wording accuracy, print-edition completeness, and the exact relationship to the Ethiopian Orthodox Church list remain unverified. It is not a canon-linked EOTC reader and is not counted as an EOTC canon reader or toward canon reader coverage.
